benchmark_selection_basis: simulator-only validity; no FastWAM inference has been run on any move_block_reveal_can version
bug_classification: pre-policy scripted-expert instrumentation correction only; scene geometry, sampling, conditions, seeds, horizon, camera, instruction, visibility, success, and difficulty are unchanged from V0.3/V0.3.4
reason: V0.3.4 reset passed all three-condition paired-state, visibility, stability, and screenshot assertions, but Missing scripted expert was rejected by two instrumentation defects. First, RoboTwin check_actors_contact treated PhysX contact-offset proximity pairs as collisions: 998 sampled points all had positive 0.0161690 to 0.0199996 m separation and exactly zero impulse while the can moved at most 8.996e-7 m and rotated at most 2.061e-4 rad. V0.3.5 keeps raw pair diagnostics but defines physically meaningful expert interference as signed separation <= 0 or applied impulse > 0, with the independent can pose guards unchanged. Second, the executed AABB clearance missed the existing tolerance boundary by 5.268e-6 m; V0.3.5 adds a fixed 0.005 m scripted lift command buffer while retaining the same required clearance and validation tolerance. No scene or evaluation definition changed, and no FastWAM result was available.
